Mapping the Polar Neuro-Interactome of Garcinia mangostana Against the AD-PD-ALS Nexus

Key enriched KEGG signaling pathways associated with GMPE targets, including (A) PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (hsa04151), and (B) MAPK signaling pathway (hsa04010), illustrating molecular nodes involved in neuronal survival, inflammation, and stress response. Pathway diagrams were reproduced according to KEGG guidelines [52]
